Wyll disfavors harming the innocent or letting their grief persist, as well as any nefarious deeds.

He disapproves of villainous acts such as killing the defenseless, or refusing to save the abused. He loathes dishonesty and cruelty towards others, as well as aiding or permitting evil. Raised to support honor and valor, he despises injustice and attempts to gain profit through deception. Being tricked into a pact with a fiend, Wyll natively detests almost anything connected to devils. Finally, he does not appreciate most any crime or countering legitimate and honorable authority, nor being dismissive of his own family grudgings and relations with his father.

The story and dialogue choices listed on this page lower  Wyll's approval.

All entries for disapproval values shown on this page come directly from official in-game dialogue files as of Patch 7. However, in any given playthrough, specific changes in disapproval may not trigger for several reasons, primarily among them: installed mods or a game bug.[1]

For more information about the approval system, see Approval.

Act One

Locations

Ravaged Beach and Roadside Cliffs

  • Accept Astarion's apologies and say you would have done the same (-1) ( The Dark Urge characters have unique line here)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, tear off Gale's hand (-1)

Emerald Grove

In The Hollow:

  • Take a swing at Zevlor during his argument with Aradin (-1)
  • Refuse to help Zevlor persuade Kagha to let the tieflings stay (-1)
  • Scold Elegis for being scared of a few goblins OR tell her to get to digging their own graves (-1) (either option)
  • Tell Arron that tiefling refugees will be fine due to their devilish powers (-1)
  • Tell the tiefling kids trained by Asharak that they are going to die (-1)
  • Tell Pandirna to hush or you will snap her neck (-1) (Available for all classes except  Barbarian)
  • Convince Arka to spare Sazza (using  Persuasion,  Intimidation or  Detect Thoughts) (-1)
    • OR Fail to  intimidate Arka or to use  Detect Thoughts on her (-1) (either option)
  • Promise Sazza that you will help her escape (-1) and then indeed free her (-1)
  • Refuse Zevlor when he asks to kill the goblin horde's leaders (-1)
  • Playing as a  Lolth-Sworn Drow, talking to Mol after having messed with one of her friends, threaten to tear her spine out (-1)
    • If confronting Mol about your stolen belongings,  threaten to rip her tail off (-1) (Available for all classes except  Barbarian)
  • After successfully stealing the Idol of Silvanus for Mol, tell her you will be keeping it (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Rogue, advise her not to ask, just take (-1)
  • Choose not to meddle in Meli's and Barth's argument about the locket (-1)
    • OR Tell Meli to hand over the locket. When he says he doesn't have it, tell him he's on his own (-1)
    • OR Say that "There's already one thief to bury today." (-1)

Note: This line is available only if Arabella has died

  • Make Barth pay you for his locket, if you get it back from Meli (-1)
  • While talking to/trading with Mattis, catch Silfy trying to pickpocket you and grab her by the hand (-1)

In the Sacred Pool and druid caves:

  • Do nothing when Kagha is threatening Arabella (-1)
  • After resolving Arabella's fate, tell Kagha that you would have killed the girl outright (-5)
    • OR Tell her you just wanted to see what would happen (-5)
    • OR Tell her that it was quite a show (-5)
    • OR Praise Kagha for protecting her own (-1)
    • If Arabella died, speak to Rath and blame the child (-1)
  • Prod Nettie's bird twice (-1)
  • Playing as a  Rogue, pick Mirkon's pockets while he is charmed by the harpies (-1)
    • After saving Mirkon from the harpies, tell him to stop snivelling (-1)
  • Tell Alfira she should give up on her song (-1)
    • Steal Alfira's extra lute (-1)
    • Take Alfira's lute out of her hands and smash it (-1)
  • Kick Timber the squirrel (-1)
    • If you miss, try to kick her again (-1)
    • Playing as  The Dark Urge, when confronted by a companion about kicking Timber, answer that it came right at you OR that your instincts are sharp (-1)

While the Emerald Grove is preparing for the goblin attack

  • Tell Pandirna that you are here for the show (-1)
  • Tell Zevlor (or Asharak if Zevlor is dead) that it was you who led the horde to the grove, and then that this place belongs to the Absolute (-10)
    • OR That the horde is coming, led by the drow - and you are with them (-10)
    • OR, Playing as  The Dark Urge, tell Zevlor that the goblin horde is yours (-1)
  • Tell Mirkon you are not going to save him again OR that he's on his own (-1) (the formulation depends on whether you saved Mirkon from the harpies or not)
  • Betray the Grove (open the gate) after blowing the horn (-10)

Sunlit Wetlands/Putrid Bog

  • After Auntie Ethel disappears, tell Demir and Johl they are on their own (-1)
    • OR Playing as a  Ranger, a  Sorcerer or a  Wizard, tell brothers to "trust a more experienced soul" (-1)

In the Overgrown Tunnel:

  • Chasing after Auntie Ethel in her lair, speak to Lorin and ROAR at him (-1)
  • When Ethel surrenders, let her go and keep Mayrina in exchange for fey hair (-5)
  • If you killed Auntie Ethel and spared Mask of Regret, speak to the latter afterwards and choose to attack her (-1)
  • Allow Auntie Ethel to take your eye as a payment for ridding you of the tadpole (-1)
  • Resurrect Connor Vinderblad, then choose to keep the Bitter Divorce wand to yourself (-1)

Forest and Blighted Village

  • Talking with Scratch via  Speak with Animals, shout at the Gomwick's corpse to prove he indeed is dead (-1)
  • While talking to Aradin on the bridge, say you don't waste your time with devilspawn (-1)
  • Interrupt the bugbear and ogre lovers in the barn (-1)
  • Pay Fezzerk a lot of gold to let you pass (-1)
    • OR Attack the gang and, when Fezzerk begs for mercy, spare him (-5)
  • Untie Barcus Wroot off the windmill vane and demand a compensation from him (-1)

Goblin Camp

At the gate and in the outer camp:

  • Smear the dung over your face on Sentinel Olak's demand (-1)
  • Tell Tracker Grikka that you will get answers from prisoners (-1)
  • Using  Speak with Animals, tell the Dishevelled Chicken to shut up and play (-1)
    • OR Instruct the chicken to run to the finish posts (-1)

Note: These options are available if you have killed the Owlbear Cub in its nest

Dealing with Crusher:

  • Kiss Crusher's foot (-1), then start licking it (-1)
    • OR Give his foot a long lick straightaway (-1)
    • If Crusher attacks you, defeat him, then say you've made a point and help him get up (-1)

Inside the Shattered Sanctum:

  • Tell Torturer Spike to let you put the prisoner through paces (-1)
    • OR Use a race-based line for a  Drow or unique line for  The Dark Urge (-1) (either option)
    • Then torture Liam yourself (-1)
  • After questioning Liam, leave him chained to the rack (-1)
  • Convince Minthara to spare Sazza, saying the latter didn't know who you were (-1)

Note: Sazza must be freed from the cage in Emerald Grove

  • Agree to attack the Grove with Minthara with or without asking for a reward (-5)

In the Worg Pens:

  • Tell goblin children to keep at the bear, to aim for his eye, or to use sharper stones (-1) (either option)
    • Throw a rock yourself (-1) (Makes Halsin hostile)
  • Refuse Halsin to help him save the grove after freeing him (-5)

Underdark and Grymforge

  • Agree to hunt down Thulla for Gekh Coal, for reward or for free (-1)
  • Steal Boots of Speed from Thulla while she's helpless (-1)
  • After defeating the duergar, agree to eliminate Sovereign Spaw for Glut (-1)
    • If Baelen Bonecloak ate the Noblestalk himself, tell Derryth Bonecloak you know exactly what you've done (-1)

In Grymforge:

  • Ask Ward Magmar how to get a slave of your own (-1)
  • After killing Magmar and Pistle, tell Skickpit to use the elevator to surface (-1) (further options to convince the gnome won't bring any points)
  • After rescuing Nere, tell him to finish the slaves, OR Choose to say nothing (-5) (either option)
  • Side with Nere against Elder Brithvar (-1)
  • If you killed the duergar (both rebels and Absolutists) before freeing Nere, kill the gnome slaves as well, when he orders you to (-5)
  • After defeating Nere, ask the duergar about the gnome slaves and say that they are a valuable asset (-5)

The Risen Road, Waukeen's Rest and Zhentarim Hideout

  • If you have raided the Emerald Grove before recruiting Karlach, convince her it was a necessary move (-1)
  • Tell Rugan that you are here for the cargo, not to rescue him (-1)
  • Tell Counsellor Florrick that she needs to find someone else to rescue Duke Ravengard (-5)
  • Agree to find the missing shipment for Zarys (-1)

Note: Distracts a point regardless of whether you know the truth about cargo's fate or not

  • Kill Rugan, if you conspired with him about missing shipment and he survived Zarys's torture and your fight against other Zhentarim (-1)
  • After purchasing Oskar Fevras from Brem, speak to the artist and call him a slave twice (-5)

Mountain Pass and Crèche Y'llek

  • Attack Ellyka near the point of encounter with githyanki patrol (-1)
    • OR, Being  disguised as a gith, provoke her to attack you (-1)

In Crèche Y'llek:

  • Tell Varsh Ko'kuu that if he gives you the Githyanki Egg you'll sell it at best price OR make yourself an omelette (-1) (either option)
  • Crush the Githyanki Egg (-1) (Not available for a  Githyanki character)

Note: Any threat of doing harm to the egg or its destruction makes Ko'kuu and hatchery guards hostile

  • Offer to fight Youth Varrl when Sa'varsh Kethk asks for a challenger (-1), and then indeed kill him (-1)
  • Tell Vlaakith you are a friend who brought the artefact to her (-1)
    • OR Rat Shadowheart out that it was she who stole it (-1) (Available only if Shadowheart is in the party)
  • Agree to Vlaakith's demand to kill the person inside the Mysterious Artefact (-1)
  • Steal the Blood of Lathander from the Secret Chamber (-1)

Note: This point is distracted only if you steal the mace. If it is taken using the Dawnmaster's Crest, no disapproval follows.

Campsite and Conversations

Raphael's deal

  • When Raphael briefly takes you to the House of Hope, say that you'll do anything to get rid of the tadpole (-1)
  • Discussing the devil's offer afterwards:
    • Say you should at least hear the him out/consider his offer (-1)
    • OR Say that no cost is too great, if it rids you of infection (-1)
    • OR Tell Wyll you should refuse the devil like he refused Mizora (-1) (Available if you have already met her)

Camp interactions

  • If Arabella died, talk to Wyll and call her a thief OR Say it was her fault (-3) (either option)
    • OR Say that the matter was not your business, OR Say that Kagha was right (-3) (either option)
  • When discussing the delayed ceremorphosis, propose to dig up some poison mushrooms (-1)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, confess to murdering the bard (-1)
    • OR Fail the roll to  deceive the others by any story (-1)

Other companions and camp followers

  • When other companions find out that Astarion is a vampire:
    • Say you think he won't hurt any of you (-1)
    • OR Tell them that if they don't like it, they can leave (-1)
  • Playing as Astarion origin, confess to Wyll of being a vampire, then fail  Persuasion or  Deception roll to explain why you kept it a secret (-3)
    • Then say you cannot promise to keep your fangs out of innocent flesh (-5)

Note: The same options are available if Wyll confronts you about biting him or anyone other, including enemies

  • Playing as Shadowheart origin, confess to Wyll of worshipping  Shar, but fail the  Charisma roll
  • When Lae'zel and Shadowheart have an argument over the Mysterious Artefact:
    • When either of them attacks another sneakily at night, choose to do nothing (-1) (the attacked one dies)
  • Choose to attack the Owlbear Cub when he comes to the camp (-1) (works either at first or second appearing, with or without  Speak with Animals)

Companion quest

  • When discussing how he became The Blade of Frontiers, say that killing goblins is hardly worth to be worked up about (-2)
  • After it is revealed he is Duke Ravengard's son, tell him you are not interested in his lineage (-3)
    • After Wyll mentiones a taste for a good wine, say you find him a bit smug (-1)
  • Playing as a  Wizard,  Warlock,  Sorcerer or  Cleric, examine his false eye, ask him whether it is a sending stone. Then succeed a passive  Insight check and probe his mind with illithid  Wisdom power (-5) (works regardless of Wisdom roll result)

If Karlach was spared:

  • Flirt with Mizora (-1)
  • Ask Mizora whether she will leave if you turn on Karlach (-1)
  • After Mizora warps Wyll, ask how does it feel to be a devil, then call him hideous freak (-3)

Act Two

Locations

Ruined Battlefield

If entering the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Grymforge:

  • When the Shadows warp Harper Yonas, choose to run from the fight (-1)

If entering the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Rosymorn Monastery Trail:

  • Traversing Shadow-Cursed Lands with the convoy and Kar'niss the drider, protect them from Harpers, thus maintaining your cover as a True Soul (-1)
    • OR Side with the ambushing Harpers. Then, after defeating the convoy, tell the Harpers' leader you're going to kill them and keep the Moonlantern (-1)

Note: Taking this course immediately starts the fight with remaining Harpers. Works, too, if you managed to pick up the Moonlantern during the battle

  • If ambushing the convoy with the Harpers, start the dialogue with the drider and reveal the ambush to it (-1)

When dealing with He Who Was:

  • Order Madeline to hurt herself as Ben and Marc did (-1) (Evil  Cleric characters have unique line here)
    • Then tell her to stab herself and don't stop OR to prove she is sorry (-1) (either option)
    • Finally, succeed a  Persuasion roll to keep her going (-1)

Elsewhere:

  • When talking to Dolly Thrice, ignore her pleads two times and keep the Moonlantern (-1)
  • After saving Rolan from the Shadows, tell him to shut up and be grateful (-1)

Last Light Inn

Speaking to Jaheira:

  • When talking to Jaheira inside the inn, tell her that you drink to darkness that will come when you drag Isobel to Moonrise Towers (-10) (Available is you have Z'rell's orders to do it)

Dealing with Isobel and Marcus:

  • If Marcus vouched for you at the entrance (in this case he will wait in Isobel's room):
    • Agree to help him kidnap Isobel OR say that you are going to take the cleric yourself (-1) (either option)
    • OR Speak to Isobel and say that she is coming with you (-10)
  • If Marcus assaults the inn (happens if you gained entrance with Mol's help):
    • After speaking to Marcus telepathically, tell Isobel that she is going to meet Ketheric face to face (-10)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, obey your Urge and tell Isobel you crave to kill her (-10)

Note: This option is available either before kidnapping attempt, or after assault, or if you return to the inn after freeing Nightsong; turns hostile Isobel and any Harper who sees it

Talking to His Majesty via  Speak with Animals:

  • Hiss back at him, say that he is in your territory, and order to get out (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Barbarian, WOOF at him (-1)

Speaking to Cerys:

  • When she tell you about their misfortunes, conclude that she abandoned others (-1) (use basic line or unique for  Barbarian,  Fighter,  Monk or  Paladin (except  Oathbreaker))
  • Ask her what they are doing here, if they headed for Baldur's Gate, and then say she did the right mess of things (-1)

Talking to Alfira:

  • After Marcus's assault, when she asks whether they cannot trust anyone, tell her to stop whining (-1)
  • Ask her about others, and then say that it was a cowardly move (-1)
  • When she asks you how do you keep going, answer that you don't complain constantly (-1)
  • When Alfira supposes that surviving tieflings were taken to the Moonrise Towers say you imagine the cultists are torturing them right now (-1)

Speaking with Bex and Danis:

  • Before trying to save captured refugees:
    • Tell Bex that Danis is now goblin chow toy OR that they've probably killed and eaten him (-1) (either option)
  • If Danis died while saving attempt, tell Bex that he is better off dead than abandoned in Moonrise (-1)

Dealing with Rolan, Cal and Lia:

  • Speaking to drunken Rolan before trying to save captured refugees:
    • Tell him that his siblings are better off dead than in cult's hands OR Tell him to stop whining (-1) (either option)
  • If either Cal or Lia (or both) died while rescue attempt, garble their names and say you don't know them (-1)
  • If both siblings survived, after they thank you, ask who is going to pay you (-1)
  • If Rolan died in battle with Shadows, tell either Cal or Lia that he died as he lived - stupidly (-1)

Talking to Ide after drunken Rolan has snapped on her:

  • Call Rolan a grump, and when Ide complains he called her a "ragged little devil", say that he was observant (-1)
  • When Ide shows you the book she means to keep for Rolan, convince her to give it to you, using  Deception or  Intimidation (-1) (either option)

Talking to Harper Meygan mourning Yonas:

  • Say that Yonas was better at joking than at keeping himself alive (-1)
    • OR Say that he'd still be around if spent less time on joking (-1)
  • If you looted Yonas's body, ask Meygan whether she would like to take Yonas's sword, then say you were kidding and keep it (-1)

Elsewhere in the inn:

  • After Mol is taken during Marcus's assault, tell Mattis she's probably dead already (-1)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, give in to your urge to kill the Strange Ox (-1)
  • Tell Counsellor Florrick you have no intentions to go to Moonrise Towers (-1)

Reithwin Town

  • At the Reithwin Tollhouse, agree to give up all your gold to Gerringothe Thorm. (-1)

At the cemetery:

  • Refuse to help Arabella find her parents (-3)
    • If you agreed, refuse to take Arabella in at your camp (-3)
  • OR, If you've already found Locke and Komira's bodies, tell Arabella they are dead and fail  Persuasion or  Intimidation roll to take her to your camp (-3)

Note:  The Dark Urge characters have unique lines and  Persuasion option only

Moonrise Towers

Witnessing Ketheric's trial (at the very first visit to Moonrise):

  • If Minthara is judged:
    • Playing as  The Dark Urge, after Ketheric declares the sentence, intervene and say you can make Minthara's passing much more creative (-1)
  • When Disciple Z'rell orders you to decide the goblins' fate, kill them through illithid powers ( The Dark Urge characters have several options, all gaining points) (-1)

Talking to Z'rell, if you have helped Balthazar to retrieve Nightsong, agree to kidnap Isobel next (-1)

At the Moonrise Towers Prison:

  • When approaching Minthara being tortured and erased by Jasin and Sumera:
    • Say you expected to see her dismembered (-1)
    • OR, Playing as  The Dark Urge, if you failed a  Wisdom check to reach out to Minthara's mind, tell the questioners to carve her mind apart (-1)
  • Talking to Lia, to Lakrissa or to Wulbren, refuse to help them escape (-1) (either of them)
  • Refuse to find tools for Wulbren (-1)

Elsewhere in Moonrise Towers:

  • While entering the Moonrise for the first time, tell Zealot Malik that you have infiltrated Harpers' encampment (-1)
  • Convince Astarion to bite Araj Oblodra OR order him directly to do it (-1) (either option)
  • At the Moonrise Towers docks, use illithid  Wisdom check on Acolyte Marls, then tell him to wash the worms off (-1)

Final fight at the Moonrise:

  • If you haven't come to Last Light Inn at all, before final fight for Moonrise Towers tell Jaheira you are a foe (-1)
  • If you saved Minthara, after killing Ketheric down in the colony talk to her and propose to take Orin's place to lead the cult (-1)
    • Then tell her "I'm with you" when she proposes claiming the Netherstones (-1)

Gauntlet of Shar

Dealing with Yurgir and his retinue:

  • Lick the dead spider meat (-2) (Comes point by point for each lick)
  • If you agreed to help Yurgir:
    • Suggest to search the temple for him (-1)
    • Speak to Nessa via  Speak with Animals and  convince her that the orthon sold her to the party (-1)
    • OR, Playing as  The Dark Urge, tell Nessa you didn't think the displacer beasts were slaves. Then discuss her love to the orthon and finally say that love is a disease like any other (-1)

Near Pedestal of Reckoning, when Shadowheart speaks of her need to go through the Shar's trials, agree to help her if you can (-1)
Speaking with Balthazar in his outpost, agree to clear the way for him (-1)

In the Shadowfell:

  • Near the Verge of Shadows, agree to search the Spear of Night for Shadowheart (if you don't have it yet) (-1)
  • If you have defeated Balthazar, kill Aylin, too (-1) (works also if playing as Shadowheart origin)
    • OR Allow Shadowheart to kill the aasimar (-1)
  • If Balthazar is present and not hostile to the party, let him take Aylin to Ketheric (-1)

Mind Flayer Colony

In the Necrotic Laboratory:

  • Talking to the Waking Mind via the Slack-Skinned Head, succeed the passive  Insight check and choose to consume their mind (-1)
  • Tell the Fresh Mind they will never wake again (-1)

After the final fight with Apostle of Myrkul

Talking to Minthara:

  • When Minthara tells you she is going to kill Orin, mention the cult might need a new leadership afterwards (-1)
    • Then tell her you are with her (-1) ( Rogue characters have additional unique line here)
  • OR Declare you will be the saviours of Baldur's Gate
    • Then agree with her that reshaping world would be glorious (-1)

Speaking to Cerys:

  • Tell her you're glad they are safe, then say they are better off without Zevlor (-1)
    • OR Say "Good riddance" (i.e. to Zevlor) (-1)
  • Say people get paid for doing jobs (-1) ( Rogue characters have unique line here)

Talking to Ide and Umi:

  • Tell any of them about Mol's eyepatch you have found down in the colony, and then:
    • Tell Ide OR Umi that their friend is dead anyway (-1) (either of them)

Speaking to others:

  • Playing as a  Bard, decline Alfira's proposal to play together for the tiefling kids (-1)
  • If you let Balthazar take Aylin from Shadowfell, AND if Isobel died, tell the aasimar you would betray her again on a whim (-1)
  • If you still haven't helped to lift the curse, tell Halsin the curse was always his burden, not yours (-1)
  • Refuse to recruit Jaheira (-1)

Campsite and Conversations

  • After talking with Raphael and Mol, talk to Wyll and say that she should consider the devil's offer (-3)

Note: Throughout the dialogue, there are three possible options with similar meaning, all bringing the same disapproval

  • Playing as Evil  Cleric, tell Arabella that being an orphan makes her much more interesting (-1) (Works after you have found her parents dead)
    • Then say she can quit snivelling (-1)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, when confronted about killing your companion instead of Isobel, pick any answer line except choosing to attack straightaway and using  Deception (-10) (either option)

Note: Choosing any of these options turns the companion who found you over the corpse hostile. The only chance to avoid a fight is to succeed  DC 30 Deception Check

  • If you killed Isobel, tell to Wyll about it (-5)
    • Then boast of your Slayer form (-5)

Companion quest

  • After saving Mizora from Mind Flayer Colony, if you failed to convince her to break the pact, tell Wyll he should give it up (-3)

Act Three

Locations

Rivington

Talking to Yenna, be rude to the girl:

  • Ask where did she last see her mum, then say her mother is probably dead (-1)
    • OR Tell Yenna to get lost (-1)


Angleiron's Cellar

  • Refuse to take the Runepowder Bomb from Wulbren but promise you'll destroy the Steel Watch Foundry your way (-1)
    • OR Call his plan is too messy and say you're out (-1)
    • OR Say that the real enemy is Gortash, not the Gondians (-1)


Circus of the Last Days
At the entrance:

  • Convince Klaus to let you in, using any  Intimidation check, bribing him OR pretending to be a friend of Gortash's (class-based  Deception check) (-1) (either option)
  • Dealing with Akabi the djinni, successfully catch him on rigging the wheel, but apologise and say you were mistaken (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Bard, spin the wheel again and try to distract the djinni, asking him about his adventures (-1)
  • Tell Boney the mephit that his wife Stoney is not your type (-1)

When passing Zethino's trial, choose answers:

    • First question: "Public adoration" (-1), OR "The day he made a pact" (-2)
    • Second question: "Himself" (-2) OR "Mizora" (-2)
    • Third question: "Joining me" (-1), OR "Making a pact" (-1), OR "Sparing Karlach" (-2)

Note: If playing as Karlach origin, the latter option will run as "Sparing me"

Dealing with caged beasts:

  • Using  Speak with Animals, tell Shadow-Whiskers that her cage looks comfy (-1)
    • Then tell her to murder whoever she wants OR Say "Sure thing, pussycat" (-1) (either option)
    • Without  Speak with Animals, choose the line "Kill them all, kitty" (-1)
  • Refuse to feed Crimson via  Speak with Animals OR Mock him for being hungry (without the spell) (-1) (either option)

Watching Dribbles's show:

  • Yell "Boo! Get off the stage!" (-1)
  • When false Dribbles asks for an assistant, choose to cross your arms and glare (-1)
    • OR Just answer "No." (-1)
    • Playing as a  Warlock, if going on stage yourself, choose a class-based line as an explanation on why you're special (-2)
  • Talk to Lucretious after defeating false Dribbles, and when she asks you to find the real clown, answer that you are expensive (-1)


In the Requisitioned Barn:

  • Talk to Fist Broadhorn inside the barn and say you were just looking for anything worth stealing (-1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Rogue, if you are caught inside the Requisitioned Barn by Fist Madigan, tell him this is the only place around worth stealing from (-1)


Elsewhere in Rivington

  • Stand for Saer Grotpoll protesting against refugees, saying "Out with these interlopers!" (-1)
  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, offer Arfur Gregorio to chase the refugees out for free and explain that you just enjoy brutalizing the poor (-1)
